title: Craft, Customize, Play: Help Us Create Games with Rosebud AI Copilot!
author: RosebudAI
selftext:
Hello fellow gamers and AI enthusiasts,

We're [**Rosebud AI**](https://www.rosebud.ai/)! We’ve built a coding editor that leverages Large Language Models and generative AI to turn everyday language into code, creating a fully playable game.

Just to give you a taste of what we’re doing, here’s our first demo:

https://reddit.com/link/14nhhf0/video/zxzf5u34499b1/player

If you’re curious about what we’re building or want to join our early access, we’d love for you to join our [**Discord Server**](https://discord.com/invite/rosebud-ai) or sign up at [**Rosebud.AI**](http://rosebud.ai/). Your experiences, ideas, and feedback are vital in helping us make [Rosebud.AI](http://rosebud.ai/) a real game-changer (pun intended!)

We’re excited to hear what you think,

Team Rosebud

comments.author: StickiStickman
comments.body: Is there an actual demo? The video is obviously super heavily scripted and edited and leaves out 99%

replies.author: RosebudAI
replies.body: We do have a detailed demo coming out this week- sign up for our waitlist for the full thing. I’ll respond to your comment directly once its out!
